title: Finite presieve reindexing over a fixed stage target
statement: Let J be a small filtered category and F : J → Cat a diagram [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let V be a cocone such that its object and arrow cocones [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] are colimits of sets. Fix stages j₀ and k₀, objects T₀ in F(j₀) and U₀ in F(k₀), and a presieve R₀ on U₀ with finite uncurried arrow set. Suppose the cocone images of T₀ and U₀ equal an object S of V.pt. Let f_t : X_t → S be a family indexed by a finite type τ whose generated presieve is the equality-transported cocone image of R₀. Then there are a common stage j, transitions e : j₀ → j and d : k₀ → j, a target equality h : F(d)(U₀) = F(e)(T₀), and arrows a_t : A_t → F(e)(T₀), such that their generated presieve is h-transport of R₀.map F(d), and the cocone image of every a_t equals f_t as an object of the arrow category. No precoverage or covering assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 09YL, finite-diagram observation and verification of axiom (2); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YL

proof.text: Choose for every requested index a member of the stage presieve with the same image arrow, and for every stage member an index with that image. Presieve.map_iff and Presieve.ofArrows_surj give these comparisons, including source equality.

Each stage member and the representative selected for its chosen index have equal colimit images. Apply eventual arrow equality to each of these finitely many pairs, then IsFiltered.wideSpan to obtain a single transition on which every comparison holds. Equality of arrow objects implies membership in the same presieve, giving equality of the transition presieve and the selected indexed presieve.

Use eventual object equality to align the transitioned presieve target with the prescribed initial stage target. Map the selected arrows to that common successor and postcompose with eqToHom of the target equality. Transport of ofArrows gives equality with the transported original presieve. Cocone naturality and Arrow.arrow_mk_comp_eqToHom give each prescribed image equality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YL finite-diagram observation; S3 formalized finite comparisons and endpoint transport

mathlib_searches.query: A finite presieve whose image in a filtered colimit is an indexed family can be reindexed by this family at a later stage

lean.statement:
theorem colimit_presieve_indexed_presentation
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (V : Cocone F) (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (j₀ k₀ : J) (T₀ : F.obj j₀) (U₀ : F.obj k₀) (R₀ : Presieve U₀)
    [Finite R₀.uncurry] {S : V.pt}
    (hT : (V.ι.app j₀).toFunctor.obj T₀ = S)
    (hU : (V.ι.app k₀).toFunctor.obj U₀ = S)
    {τ : Type u} [Finite τ] {X : τ → V.pt} (f : ∀ t, X t ⟶ S)
    (hR : hU ▸ R₀.map (V.ι.app k₀).toFunctor = Presieve.ofArrows X f) :
    ∃ (j : J) (e : j₀ ⟶ j) (d : k₀ ⟶ j)
      (h : (F.map d).toFunctor.obj U₀ = (F.map e).toFunctor.obj T₀)
      (A : τ → F.obj j) (a : ∀ t, A t ⟶ (F.map e).toFunctor.obj T₀),
      Presieve.ofArrows A a = h ▸ R₀.map (F.map d).toFunctor ∧
      ∀ t, Arrow.mk ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.map (a t)) = Arrow.mk (f t)
